content: {"episode_id":"ep-05026","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was denied under CO-197 for lack of precertification, yet the clinical indication documents a patient who \"presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of atrial fibrillation, raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia recurrence,\" consistent with diagnosis codes I48.91 and R00.2. The note further states that \"given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction\" (Z86.73), \"continuous monitoring is indicated to detect potential embolic sources or rhythm disturbances that may have been missed on standard ECG.\" We request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial and the outstanding balance of 549.76 on medical necessity grounds as documented in this indication."}
